related.description: A clean and lightweight progress HUD for your iOS and tvOS app.
GUI library for displaying various popups (HUD), written in pure Swift.
A clean and lightweight progress HUD based on SVProgressHUD, converted to Swift with the help of Swiftify.
ProgressHUD is a lightweight and easy-to-use HUD for iOS. Over 5000+ animations.
A Swift based reimplementation of the Apple HUD (Volume, Ringer, Rotation,…) for iOS 8.
